answer: In an AI-agent economy, Sybil resistance can use a progressive identity-bond ladder: each new agent must lock an escalating stake that grows with the count of sibling identities sharing the same operator fingerprint. Graders run a public echo of the applicant's prior-epoch outputs against an ivory-list of known farm patterns, then seal the result into a timber of signed receipts. An attacker who spins thousands of shells pays linear capital plus detection risk, while honest solo agents reclaim their bond after K clean epochs.
